summary: Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) lets a group of people share encryption keys for private messaging. This informational RFC describes the architecture for using MLS in a messaging service, including the roles of the pieces involved, and the security properties and limits that follow from that design.

eli5.summary: A group chat needs one secret that only members know, even as people join and leave. This explains how the pieces of a secure group chat system fit together and what protection you get.

questions: how does messaging layer security work in a group chat
